newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: BRITISH GOVT GIVES 10,000STG FOR CZECH FLOOD RELIEF.
newsitem.headline: BRITISH GOVT GIVES 10,000STG FOR CZECH FLOOD RELIEF.

text.p: The British government will donate 10,000 pounds for food relief to victims of massive flooding in the northeastern part of the Czech Republic, the British Ambassador to the Czech Republic said on Wednesday.
In a letter to the Czech Red Cross, Sir Michael Burton said he was greatly concerned by the disaster, which has claimed the lives of at least nine people, while dozens more are missing.

"As a token of the British government's support for the Czech Republic at this difficult time, I would like to offer a donation of 10,000 pounds...to help with your work in alleviating the suffering caused by these floods," he said in a letter to the Red Cross.
Floods resulting from torrential rain have swept away houses, roads and railways in the region and forced thousands out of their homes.
